topic: All 22 Kylian Mbappé World Cup goals 2018 to 2026, goal by goal with opponent captions
hook: Black screen with animated white 'M FOOTBALL' logo stinger for ~8 s before first match clip
subtitle_style: small white caption bottom-left with goal number and opponent (e.g. '1.PERU', '2.ARGENTINA'); 'World Cup 2018' bottom-right; small M logo top-right
transition_summary: Hard cuts within goals, ~16s logo intro; counter caption changes per goal; roughly 2-3 cuts/10s with detected cuts about every 2-6s after intro
audio_note: Original English broadcast commentary of each goal ('Antoine Griezmann and Mbappé gives France the lead') with crowd, possible music bed

reuse_segments.what: Mbappé World Cup goal clips (2018 onward) with commentary
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Needs FIFA/broadcaster-licensed footage; reuse caption layout (goal #. opponent) only
